Commentary.Commentary: We are all set for the chase. During the break, a tribute was given to the late Andrew Symonds. The players are out in the middle. David Warner and Aaron Finch are the openers for Australia. Wesley Madhevere to start with the ball.
...The Chase...

It was a superb bowling display from Australia! Aaron Finch rotated his bowlers brilliantly and they bowled to the plans. Cameron Green was the main architect of Zimbabwe's downfall as he grabbed his first five wicket haul. Josh Hazlewood too despite not taking a wicket showed his class as he bowled an economical spell. The leggie, Adam Zampa ended with three wickets. Overall, it was an excellent bowling effort from the hosts but all the headlines will be taken by Cameron Green and deservingly so for his effort. Now then, a par score and Australia dearly fancy a win here. Zimbabwe need to grab a couple of wickets inside the Powerplay to put some pressure on Australia. Will they be able to do so? We will find out after the break.

Zimbabwe will be disappointed with their effort. They were cautious at the start and the top order gave a good platform for the upcoming batters to carry on with the momentum but they succumbed under the pressure.  Tadiwanashe Marumani and Wesley Madhevere put on a good stand but once they fell. Zimbabwe slipped from 185/4 to all out on 200. Zimbabwe were too slow in the middle phase and that made them go for big shots in the death overs which resulted in wickets.
It was yet another classic display of bowling from the mighty Aussie. They had the match in control throughout the innings and now have a chance to go 1-0 up in the series.

OUT! TIMBER! Mitchell Starc ends with a wicket as well! A classic Starc delivery! On a length and around off. Victor Nyauchi makes room to cut through point but he misses and the ball disturbs the off pole. Zimbabwe are all out on 200.
A yorker but around leg. Victor Nyauchi jams it out to backward point.
Length ball on middle, guided through point for a couple. 200 up!
Short of a length and outside off. Richard Ngarava slashes and misses.
Almost had another wicket! Length and on top of off. Ngarava has a wild swing across and misses. The ball rolls over the off pole.

OUT! CAUGHT! Cameron Green with a five-fer! What a spell from him! Excellent stuff! Short of a length and outside off. Evans pulls it to deep mid-wicket where Glenn Maxwell keeps his nerves near the fence. A big smile on Green's face and why not as he has delivered a brilliant spell. His maiden five-wicket haul.
Commentary.Howout: c Glenn Maxwell b Cameron Green

Commentary.Commentary: Length and outside off. Evans lofts it over covers for a couple of runs.
Richard Ngarava is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Cameron Green gets his fourth wicket! What a spell he is having! Absolutely brilliant from him! Just keeps it simple! This is full and on leg. Jongwe makes a bit of room and tries to heave it over but he was targeting the longer side and holes one to Glenn Maxwell at deep mid-wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Glenn Maxwell b Cameron Green

Commentary.Commentary: On a length and on off. Evans chips it to mid on for a single.
Full toss on off, pushed to covers.
On a length and on middle, angling in. Evans tries to work on the leg side, but closes the bat face too early and top edges it to deep cover for a single.
Leg bye! Slants a yorker, around leg. Jongwe misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. It rolls to fine leg for a leg bye.
A yorker now, around off. Jongwe squeezes it out to point.
Edged away! Length ball, outside off, slanting in. Jongwe looks to cut but gets an outside edge to third man where Josh Hazlewood dives to his left and stops it. Two runs.
Length and on middle, flicked past mid-wicket for one.
Brad Evans walks out.

OUT! TAKEN! Cameron Green gets his third wicket and the visitors are falling apart! Burl was never comfortable out there! This is on a length and around middle. Ryan Burl miscues his pull shot completely and gets a top edge to third man where it goes to Josh Hazlewood who doesn't drop many catches.
Commentary.Howout: c Josh Hazlewood b Cameron Green

Commentary.Commentary: Full ball on middle. Jongwe chips it to mid on for a quick single.
On a length and on middle. Burl works it through square leg for one.
Luke Jongwe comes in.

OUT! TAKEN! Another set batter goes now! Green serves it full and on middle. Chakabva tries to get underneath the ball and launch it over mid on but doesn't get the required connection. The ball lobs high and to mid on where Mitchell Starc takes the skier.
Commentary.Howout: c Mitchell Starc b Cameron Green

Commentary.Commentary: Angling on middle, flicked to fine leg for a single.

Leg bye! Shorter and around off, this one doesn't bounce much. Chakabva looks to pull but gets hit on the helmet. It lobs to square leg for a leg bye. A concussion protocol is on. Aaron Finch is quick to check if Chakabva is okay and he look fine.
Length and on off, played back to the bowler. That is the end of a very good spell from Josh Hazlewood. No wickets but it was a superb display of bowling.
Around off, pushed to point.
That one got big on Burl! Short in length and outside off. Burl wears high on the bat, actually gets hit on the gloves. It drops on the deck.
On a length and outside off. Burl works it to covers.
On the hips, nudged to square leg for one.
Short in length and outside off. Chakabva looks to work on the leg side but misses.
Ryan Burl is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Adam Zampa strikes on his last ball and breaks this stubborn stand! A googly, slower in the air, full and around leg. Wesley Madhevere makes room and drives it straight back to Zampa who takes it with ease. Wesley Madhevere gifts away his wicket but he has played a very fine knock here.
Quicker, full and Chakabva works it to long on for a single.
Tossed up, wide of off. Wesley Madhevere reverse sweeps it past point for a single.
FOUR! Poor delivery! Short ball on middle and Wesley Madhevere pulls it hard behind square leg for a boundary.
Slower through the air, full and on middle, tucked to mid-wicket.
Tossed up on middle, flicked to square leg for a single.
Length ball, outside off, slower and Wesley Madhevere misses his drive.
A single as this is hit to deep mid-wicket.

FOUR! Zimbabwe have changed gears now! Chakabva almost gave his wicket here. Short and outside off. Chakabva pulls it flat to deep mid-wicket. Glenn Maxwell runs to his right and tries to take a one handed stunner but that was a hard one to catch. It runs past him for four.
Short in length and outside off. Wesley Madhevere pulls it and it drops safely to deep mid-wicket. One more.
A single as this is flicked to deep mid-wicket.
Chakabva played all over it! on a length and outside off. Chakabva tries to scoop it over but misses.
Shorter and outside off, cut to deep point for a single.
Flatter and on leg. Chakabva gets across and keeps it out.
A googly, fuller and on off. Wesley Madhevere fails to read but inner edges his shot to long on for a single.
Outside off, Wesley Madhevere tries to reverse sweep but finds short third man.
Too full and on middle, pushed to long on for a single.
Tossed up, slower in the air and on middle, swept to square leg for one.
Powerplay 3! Now, five fielders are allowed outside the inner circle till the last over.
FOUR! Spanked! This one is short and around off. Regis Chakabva clears his front leg and heaves it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Short ball, this one moves away off the deck. Wesley Madhevere throws his bat at it and toe ends his shot to sweeper cover. Well short of the fielder for one.
On middle, bunted through square leg for one.
On a length and on middle. Wesley Madhevere tucks it to square leg and calls for a single. Glenn Maxwell has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Wesley makes it with a dive.
Length and on off. Wesley Madhevere bunts it to mid-wicket.
Short in length and outside off. Wesley Madhevere slashes and misses.
9 runs off the over! Just what Zimbabwe needed! Full and on off, tapped to point for a single.
A low full toss, outside off. Wesley Madhevere paddles it to fine leg for a brace.
On off, pushed to mid off.
Three runs! Zampa serves it down leg but it was a leggie. Chakabva luckily gets some bat on it and the ball rolls to fine leg for three runs. Very tight there.
Two runs! Too full and on middle. Chakabva sweeps it to deep square leg for a couple of runs.
A leggie, fuller and around off. Wesley Madhevere sweeps it past short fine leg for a single.
Flatter and on middle. Wesley Madhevere nudges it to square leg. One.
On the pads, flicked to short fine leg for a single. 150 up!
Drops it short and on middle, pulled through square leg for one.
Just short! A loopy ball, around off. Chakabva tries to go over mid off but splices it to mid off where Cameron Green dives forward and collects it on a bounce. One.
Too short and on middle, pulled to deep square leg for onw.
Leg bye! A flatter ball, angling around off. Chakabva steps down and across to sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal for LBW but the impact might have been outside off.
Tossed up on off. Wesley Madhevere lunges to defend.
Around off, swept to deep square leg for a single.
Sharp turn there, it spins away on the shorter side. Chakabva tries to play on the leg side but misses.
Very full and on off, drilled to long on for one.
FOUR! Well played! Tossed up on middle. Wesley Madhevere reverse hits it and beats the diving point fielder for four.
Around off. Defended out.
Flatter ball, outside off. Wesley Madhevere reverse sweeps it to third man for a single. His 4th ODI fifty and first against Australia. A good innings till now but Wesley needs to accelerate now.
Angling on the pads. Chakabva tickles it to short fine leg and takes a quick single.
Now stays back and nudges it to mid-wicket.
Quicker ball, full and on middle. Chakabva skips down to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Outside off, cut to deep point for a single.
Tossed up on middle. Wesley Madhevere comes down the track and lofts it over mid off for a brace. These two will try and target this over.
Just a single to start Zampa's second spell. On middle. Blocked out.
A googly but Chakabva fails to pick up. He pads it away on the leg side.
Tossed up, outside off. Wesley Madhevere prods and taps it to point for a quick single.
A googly, shorter and on leg. Wesley Madhevere keeps it out.
Tossed up on middle, steep bounce and Wesley Madhevere looks to sweep but misses and gets hit on the helmet. A concussion protocol follows now. Wesley looks fine to continue.
Tossed up, around off. Wesley Madhevere defends on the front foot.
FOUR! Welcome boundary! Short of a length and outside off. Chakabva cuts it through covers, in the gap for four.
Full and outside off, driven to mid off.
On the hips, extra bouncer and it is clipped to square leg.
A full toss on middle, eased to mid on for one.
Short ball at 138.3 clicks, outside off. Wesley Madhevere tries to ramp it over but misses.
On a length and on off. Wesley Madhevere mistimes his pull to mid-wicket.
Length ball, outside off, steered to third man for a single.
Around off, kept out.
Beautiful shot for two! On a length and outside off. Wesley Madhevere skips down and lofts it over mid off. Two runs.
On top of off, tucked to mid-wicket.
Shorter and on middle. Chakabva clips it to deep square leg for one.
Length and on off. Blocked out.
Length ball, outside off, pushed to covers. A successful over by Green.
Fuller ball on middle. Chakabva flicks it through square leg for a single.
On middle, pulled to deep mid-wicket for one.
Shorter and outside off. Madhevere misses his pull.
Regis Chakabva comes in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Smart work from Australia as they get the big fish for a cheap score. Aaron Finch kept pacers against him which is a weakness for Raza and it works for the hosts! Excellent work from Green! He serves another bumper, outside off. Raza pulls but not off the middle and it goes high up in the air and behind square on the leg side. Adam Zampa there, runs to his left and takes a sharp catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Adam Zampa b Cameron Green

Commentary.Commentary: That was a superb delivery! A length ball, around off and jags back in. Raza looks to defend it but gets beaten on the inside edge.

Drinks! The run rate have now dropped below 4 and Zimbabwe are watchful in this middle phase. Raza is still to hit the gas. He knows he has to bat deep but needs to rotate the strike more. Australia have done well till now and will hope to do the same thing till the end. Australia are on top right now and a couple of wickets will help them to be all over the visitors.
Length ball, outside off. Madhevere has a poke at it but misses.
Length ball, around middle, Raza turns it behind square leg for a single.
Four dots now! Outside off, left alone.
On middle. Raza gets inside the line and hits it to mid-wicket.
Length ball, outside off. Raza punches it to covers.
Length ball, outside off. Raza shoulders arms to it.
A single to end the over! Short in length and outside off, pulled away uppishly to deep square leg for one.
Another dot! Length ball, around off, extra bounce there. Raza keeps it out.
Raza keeps eating balls for now. This is on middle, tucked to mid-wicket.
Length and on middle. Blocked out.
Green serves a short one now on middle. Raza sits under.
Outside off, guided to third man for a single.
Too full and outside off. Raza drives it nicely but Marsh at covers dives to his right to stop it.
Shorter and outside off at 135.1 kph. Raza bends his back and lets it go.
Fuller ball on middle. Madhevere works it to mid on for a sharp single.
A bouncer now, it kept on rising on Madhevere as he tries to pull but he misses.
A length ball, outside off, slower one. Madhevere steers it to short third man.
Pitched up, outside off. Madhevere drives it to extra-cover.
Length ball, around off and nipping back in. Raza stays back to defend.
Outside off. Raza easily leaves it.
Outside off on a length. Raza drops it to point now.
Tries a bouncer now, outside off. Raza evades it well.
Length ball on off. Raza taps it to covers.
Length and nipping on middle. Madhevere tucks it to square leg for a single.
Outside off, dabbed to third man for one.
On the pads, flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
On middle, eased to mid on for a quick single.
Just away! Short of a length and outside off Madhevere tries to guide away from the man at point but Smith dives to his right and gets fingertips on it. It was a tough one but he almost plucked it.
Two more! A bit of width outside off and Madhevere drives it to the right of mid off. Warner dives there, gets a hand on it and cuts it down to two.
Length ball on middle. Madhevere pushes it to mid on.
Three dots to end the over! Length and outside off. Left alone.
Another solid block from Raza.
Length ball on top of off. Raza defends right under his eyes.
Fuller ball, on middle. Madhevere nudges it to deep square leg for a single.
Slanting on the pads. Madhevere flicks it over mid-wicket for a brace.
On a length and outside off, it skids through. Madhevere has a poke at it but misses.
Again goes down the leg side. Raza sweeps it past short fine leg for a couple now.
Sliding down the leg side. Madhevere sweeps it to fine leg for one.
Sikandar Raza walks out.

OUT! TAKEN! Excellent catch from Smith! Just superb! Munyonga goes now after couple of good hits! Zampa floats a full ball, outside off. A wrong 'un and Munyonga tries to go downtown but slices it high and over mid off. It looks like the ball will clear Smith but he tracks back, keeps his eye on the ball, and takes a brilliant forward diving catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Steven Smith b Adam Zampa

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Good shot! Zampa flights one but this is straight on the pads. Munyonga clears his front leg and lofts it high over mid on for a boundary.
100 up! Drifts one on middle, drilled to mid on.
FOUR! Finally a boundary for Zimbabwe! Tossed up on middle. Wesley Madhevere advances down the track and hammers it over mid on for four.
Just a single! Slanting on middle, it is flicked behind square on the leg side for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Wesley Madhevere punches straight to Smith at point.
On a length and outside off. Munyonga cuts it on the up and past point for a single
Length and on middle. Munyonga solidly blocks it out.
Shorter and angling on the hips, bunted behind square leg for a single.
Full and on off. Wesley Madhevere defends back to the bowler.
On middle, kept out.
The batter steps out, makes it into a low full toss, hits it hard into the ground and back to the bowler.
WIDE! Down the leg side, wided.
Plays the sweep, hits it through square leg for one.
Steps out but does not get to the pitch of the ball, he works it through square leg for one.
Fuller and on middle, this is jammed down to mid on for a run.
Tossed up on middle, defended.
Outside off, left alone by the batter. A maiden.
Good length again, this is guided to point.
Shorter and outside off, Tony Munyonga slashes but misses.
On the stumps, this is played to mid on.
On off, blocked.
Outside off, on a length. Left alone.
On middle, this turns back in. Tony Munyonga works it on the leg side for one.

OUT! TIMBER! Heart break for Tadiwanashe Marumani! He played so well till now but falls 5 short of his first half ton! Steps out but ends up yorking himself. He swings across the line and misses and it hits the stumps. A good knock from him but he would have loved to go on. Will this open the floodgates now?
Flatter and on the pads, this is worked to square leg.
The googly, it lands and turns away. Tadiwanashe Marumani looks to sweep but misses to get hit on the body.
Fuller and on middle, Tadiwanashe Marumani looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
WIDE! Short and down the leg side. Tadiwanashe Marumani looks to pull but misses.
On middle, this is whipped down to wide long on for a couple more.
Angled into the pads, this is worked down to fine leg for one.
On middle, Wesley Madhevere pushes it down to long on for one.
Flatter and on off, Tadiwanashe Marumani pushes it towards cover for one.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Around off, extra bounce. Tadiwanashe Marumani looks to play the reverse sweep but misses to get hit on the body.
Flatter and on off, kept out.
On middle, defended.
On the pads, this is swept down to fine leg for one.
Fuller and on off, Wesley Madhevere pushes it down to long off for one.
On middle, this is nudged around the corner for one.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Tadiwanashe Marumani looks to sweep but misses.
On middle, this is swept through square leg for two.
Floats it up on off, Wesley Madhevere pushes it down to long off for one.
On off, this is guided to point for one.
On the bounce! Fires it on off, Wesley Madhevere looks to push at it, it goes off the outside edge towards short third man.
This lands and turns back in. Wesley Madhevere looks to flick but is hit on the chest.
Flatter and on middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Tossed up on off, this is pushed to cover.
FOUR! Welcome into the attack, Maxwell! The reverse sweep comes out, it lands around off, he plays it really nicely, behind square on the off side for a boundary.
Fuller and on middle, this is played to mid on for one.
Nice and full! A yorker on middle, this is jammed out to mid on.
Fuller and on off, Wesley Madhevere pushes it to mid off for one.
On the pads, Tadiwanashe Marumani looks to flick but misses, it hits the pad and rolls on the leg side. A leg bye taken.
Short and on middle, the batter ducks under it.
Shorter and on off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Floats it up outside leg as he sees the batter shape up for the reverse sweep. Misses.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Maybe an inside edge! On middle, Tadiwanashe Marumani looks to sweep, there seems to be an inside edge onto the pads.
On middle, this is swept fine on the leg side for one.
Gives it air and lands it on off, Wesley Madhevere defends.
Flatter and on off, this one zips through. It is pushed to cover.
Fuller and on middle, this is driven back to the bowler.
On off, defended.
Another good run! On a length and around off, this is pushed to mid off for one.
FOUR! Tickled nice and fine! On the pads, this is worked fine on the leg side for a boundary.
BEATEN! Fuller and around off, angling away. Wesley Madhevere is beaten as he tries to drive.
Back of a length and on middle, kept out.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
Top edge but safe! Short and on middle, Wesley looks to pull, it goes off the top edge, lands safe in the fine leg region for one.

THREE OVERTHROWS! Length and on off, Wesley Madhevere looks to drive, this goes off the inside edge towards leg gully. Maxwell dives to his left and stops it. The batters go for one. Maxwell has a shy at the batter's end but misses. The fielder backing up fails to stop it with a dive. Warner at mid off runs after it and the batters take three.
Fuller and on middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
On off, this is pushed to cover for one.
FOUR! Off the inside edge! Shorter and on middle, Tadiwanashe Marumani looks to pull, this goes off the inside edge, over the stumps and past the diving keeper for a boundary. Fifty up for Zimbabwe.
Short and on the body, this is pulled through square leg for one.
On middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket for one.
On the stumps, kept out.
Shorter and on off, Wesley Madhevere stands tall and defends it.
On off, this is pushed to mid on for one.
On off, defended.
Fuller and on the pads, Wesley Madhevere looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Really well fielded! Fuller and on off, Tadiwanashe Marumani looks to drive, the fielder at mid off dives to his right and saves at least two for his side.
Another short one, Tadiwanashe Marumani has another swing at it but misses.
Shorter and around off, Tadiwanashe Marumani looks to heave it over the leg side but misses.
Good length and on off, defended.
Back of a length and on off, Tadiwanashe Marumani looks to push but is beaten.
On middle, kept out.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Kaia goes after giving a really good foundation. He will be really disappointed though! This is on a length and outside off, the ball just holds a bit and Kaia punches it straight back to Marsh, on the up and Mitchell Marsh does well to hold the ball on his follow-through.
FOUR! Fuller and angling down. Kaia clips it past the keeper to fine leg for a boundary.
This one nips back in, shorter and on middle. Kaia misses his flick and gets hit high on the pads.
Short in length and on middle. Kaia pulls it past mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Touch fuller and outside off. Kaia defends on the deck.
Powerplay 2! Now, four fielders are allowed outside the inner circle till the 40th over.
On a length and around off. Defended out.
On middle, blocked out.

Edged away! FOUR! Short of a length and outside off, jags away. Marumani hops to defend but gets an outside edge and it goes to the third man fence. A fielder at second slip and it could have been a wicket.
Overpitched and outside off, driven to the right of covers where Smith gets a hand and makes a half-stop. One.

Full and angling on the pads. Kaia misses his heave and gets hit on the pads. An appeal and up goes the finger. At first it, looked like it is going down leg but Finch takes the review. It is clearly going down the leg side. Not out it is. A desperate review from the Aussie.
On a length and outside off, nips way off the deck. Kaia has a wild swing across but misses.
No ball! Green starts with a no ball as he has overstepped! This is full and on middle, it is flicked to mid-wicket. Free hit coming up.
A single to end as this is worked to mid-wicket.
On middle, kept out.
On middle, this is pushed to mid on for one.
Outside off, left alone.
WIDE! Very short and on middle. Wided.
Half an appeal but nothing! Length and on off, it lands and moves away. Tadiwanashe Marumani looks to defend but is beaten.
On off, defended.
Another one on a length, kept out.
Good length and on off, this is defended.

That one does not stay in! Shorter and on middle, Tadiwanashe Marumani pulls it hard, it goes to the right of the fielder at mid-wicket. Marsh there dives to his right and sticks one hand out but it does not stay in.
Length and on off, this is pushed to mid off.
FOUR! Dispatched! That went to the fence quickly! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled hard through square leg and it races away to the fence. Runs starting to come now.
On middle, Tadiwanashe Marumani works it to mid-wicket.
Three to end a very good over for Zimbabwe! Tadiwanashe Marumani steps out and whacks this high and over mid-wicket. It lands and stops so three taken.
Angled into the pads, Kaia looks to flick but misses, it hits the pad and goes down to fine leg for one.
Lovely stroke again! On middle, Kaia flicks it over square leg and takes two. He is quite strong off his pads.
Fuller and on middle, Kaia flicks but to mid-wicket.
That is a beauty! Length and on off, this lands and moves away. Kaia looks to defend but is beaten.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed to mid off.
Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Good length and on off, defended.
FOUR! That is an audacious stroke! Very stylish! On the pads, Innocent Kaia flicks it over square leg and into the fence.
On off, kept out.
Length and on off, defended.
Josh has been a tad short so far! Length and on off, this one comes back in but hits Kaia high on the pads.
Starc looks to end it with a yorker but ends up serving a full toss, it is mistimed to mid on. A maiden by Starc.
On middle, defended. Can Starc bowl a maiden here?

Almost! Beaten for pace there! Tadiwanashe Marumani steps out and Starc fires in a yorker. Sneaks under the bat even before Tadiwanashe Marumani could get it down but the ball goes just past the leg pole.
Shorter and on the body, Tadiwanashe Marumani looks to flick it on the leg side but it hits the glove and rolls towards square leg.
Shorter and on middle, Tadiwanashe Marumani looks to defend but it hits the splice.
Length and on middle, kept out.
Almost! Length and on off, this one comes back in. Kaia looks to drive but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Length and outside off, Kaia swings but he gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Lands safe! Tadiwanashe Marumani steps out and this is banged short. He looks to slash at it, it goes more off the toe-end but lands safe in the point region for one.
Another one on a length and outside off, not played at.
This one lands outside off and jags back in, Innocent Kaia looks to flick but misses, it hits the pad and goes down to third man for one. Leg bye.
Uppish but wide! Length and on off, Tadiwanashe Marumani hits it on the up, it goes more off the splice down the ground towards long off for three.
Another leave as this too is well outside off.
Angling away from the off pole, left alone.
Solid from Innocent Kaia! Length again and on middle, this is played back to the bowler.
Yet another one on a length and around off, this lands and angles away. Innocent Kaia is beaten as he tries to defend.

EDGED BUT WIDE OF SECOND SLIP! Length and on off, this lands and straigthens. Tadiwanashe Marumani looks to defend, this goes off the outside edge wide of the second slip fielder and down to the third man fielder for one.
Just outside off, on a length. Left alone.
Tidy start from Josh Hazlewood! Length and on off, this is pushed to covers.
Angled into the pads, Innocent Kaia looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. Going down leg.
Back of a length and on off, Kaia stays back and defends it.
A short leg in place now, probably because of the extra bounce on offer.
Another one on a length and around off, this one takes off again after landing. Innocent Kaia looks to defend but it hits the splice of the bat.
Extra bounce again! On middle, angled into the batter. Kaia looks to defend but misses to get hit near the box.
Nicely played in the end! Length and on off, this lands and then takes off. Tadiwanashe Marumani does well to take one hand off the handle as he tries to defend, it goes down to third man for one.
Josh Hazlewood to bowl from the other end!
This lands just short! On middle, going away with the angle. Innocent Kaia looks to flick but this goes off the leading edge but lands short of mid off.
Starc has not got it right so far! Strays on the pads, this is clipped down to fine leg and a run is taken.
A yorker outside off, this is jammed down to third man for one.

Time for yet another ODI series and this can be termed as a battle between David and Goliath. It is Australia taking on Zimbabwe in the former’s den. Not many teams come here and get a positive result and you do not expect Zimbabwe to do so. It will be a massive surprise if they come even close against an Australian side which has most of its top players. Are we in for a surprise?
